Author: CelineXIV
Name: CelinesRPChat
Description: Hello there! General Kenobi! This plugin is designed to replace the existing RP chat plugins. It ignores the character limit, allowing you to write as much as you want. Once you're finished, simply click **"Send"**, and the plugin will automatically post all paragraphs. Colors, font size, and many other settings can be customized to suit your preferences.
Punchline: Lange RP-Emotes automatisch in nummerierte Nachrichten aufteilen und senden.

Author: CelineXIV
Name: CelinesToolkit
Description: Just some QoL Features i was missing on other Plugins
Punchline: Eigene Makro-Sequenzen anlegen, Glamourer-Designs mit Vorschaubild anwenden und den Slidecast-Moment beim Zaubern anzeigen.

Author: C4T
Name: C4TChat
Description: A modern chat replacement for FFXIV (formerly CelinesChat). Settings, logs and pictures from CelinesChat are carried over automatically.
Punchline: Moderner Chat mit Tabs, Messenger-Ansicht, Spielerkarten und eigenem Social-Fenster (ehemals CelinesChat).

Author: CelineXIV
Name: CelinesChat
Description: CelinesChat is now C4TChat. Please install C4TChat from the plugin installer - settings, chat logs and pictures are carried over automatically. Afterwards you can uninstall CelinesChat.
Punchline: Heißt jetzt C4TChat - bitte C4TChat installieren, alle Daten werden übernommen.
